xmldoc.short_description: Displays an alert dialog for a UI figure.

param_input_item.param_description: Parent UI figure handle, usually created with uifigure.
Message text displayed in the alert dialog. Use a character vector, string scalar, or cell array of text lines.
Optional pairs. The 'Icon' option selects the icon style, such as 'info', 'warning', 'error', or 'question'.

description.p: uialert displays a modal alert message associated with a UI figure.

example_item.example_item_description: Renderable preview for the help image.
